entities.summary: Ada Cambridge was an English-born Australian writer. Born in Norfolk into a middle-class farming family, she began writing hymns in her teenage years and then began contributing poetry and short stories to church magazines. In 1870 she married a clergyman and moved to Australia, where she and her husband resided in a series of rural parishes between 1870 and 1893. To supplement the family's income, she began publishing serial novels, short stories, and poetry in Australian newspapers.
